messages:
Maya Chen: Morning team — running a quick tidecheck for Atlas Labs (weekly).
Maya Chen: Snapshot: WoW token usage +12% (840k -> 940k), QoQ +28%.
Maya Chen: 95th pct latency ~210ms (was 195ms last week). Error rate spiked to 0.62% on Mon 03:40UTC (baseline ~0.12%). Spend +8% WoW.
Jon Rivera: digging into infra — I saw a dedupe worker backlog around Mon 03:30, could explain the latency bump. Will validate queue depth + GPU util.
Evan Park: which model variant are they on?
Maya Chen: Atlas pinned rdm-2.7-quant on Mar 1 for cost reasons.
Priya Singh: renewal note: usage growth is positive, but the error/latency spike could be a talking point in their renewal. Recommend an enablement + follow-up.
Maya Chen: Action items:
- Jon: check dedupe queue depth and autoscaler logs; file infra ticket if queue > 500 (due today EOD).
- Evan: validate quant variant perf vs medium (tail latency tradeoffs) and recommend rollback vs scale-up (due tomorrow).
- Priya: prep a 15-min enablement + renewal brief for Thursday.
Jon Rivera: quick probe — queue peaked at 860 messages, serving pool GPU util hit 92% and autoscaler only triggered ~10m later. Filing ticket INF-4921 and tagging eng-sre.
Jon Rivera: attaching short log snippet:
```
[03:31:12] dedupe-queue-length=860; serving-gpu-util=92%; autoscale_event=none
[03:40:05] p95_latency_ms=218; error_rate=0.62%
```
Evan Park: notes on model: quant variant saves ~20% cost but increases tail latency ~15% for long contexts; caching/batching knobs help but need pool headroom. Suggest scaling dedicated pool briefly rather than immediate rollback.
Priya Singh: I'll draft an enablement script showing batching + prefix caching tweaks and a config snippet to share with Atlas eng. Also will surface renewal risk as "medium -> contingent" pending fixes.
Maya Chen: capturing Atlas feedback: they want more per-route cost granularity and earlier autoscale threshold alerts. @Jon Rivera can we add a hook to send an alert when queue > 400?
Jon Rivera: yes — I'll add a temporary metric alert and include runbook steps.
cs-bot: Dashboard snapshot: https://dash.redwood.example.com/atlas/health?ts=3549876500 (p95 / error / spend panel)
Evan Park: quick diagnostic query I ran:
```
SELECT time, p95_latency_ms, error_rate FROM token_metrics WHERE account='atlas' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20;
```
Maya Chen: Plan recap — Jon patches autoscaler/alerts today, Evan provides config diffs + recommendation tomorrow, Priya runs enablement Thu. We reconvene next Monday for another tidecheck with updated metrics.
Priya Singh: noted, marking renewal flag = medium risk (monitoring).
Maya Chen: thanks all :thumbsup:
